# value

In [EhOsContract.Domain](domain-dsl.md), section `domain`.

```elixir
value name, type \\ nil
```

A value type: one built-in type with an optional unit, or a set of fields.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="domain-value-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The value's name, used as a field type. |
| <a id="domain-value-type"></a>`type` | `any \| keyword` |  |  | The built-in type, when the value is not a set of fields. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="domain-value-unit"></a>`unit` | `atom` |  |  | What a number counts, e.g. `:grosze`. |
| <a id="domain-value-label"></a>`label` | `String.t` |  |  | What the business calls it. |
| <a id="domain-value-context"></a>`context` | `atom` |  |  | The context the value belongs to. |
| <a id="domain-value-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the value comes from in the material. |

Inside it: [`field`](#domain-value-field), [`invariant`](#domain-value-invariant).

<a id="domain-value-invariant"></a>

## value.invariant

```elixir
invariant name, label
```

What is true of every value of the type, with values that break it and keep it.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="domain-value-invariant-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The invariant's name, and the name of the function that checks it. |
| <a id="domain-value-invariant-label"></a>`label` | `String.t` | yes |  | The rule, as the business states it. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="domain-value-invariant-violated_by"></a>`violated_by` | `list(any)` | yes |  | Values that break it, as plain data: each is a test that the check refuses it. |
| <a id="domain-value-invariant-satisfied_by"></a>`satisfied_by` | `list(any)` | yes |  | Values that keep it, as plain data: each is a test that the check lets it through. |
| <a id="domain-value-invariant-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the rule comes from in the material. |
